snippet.title: STEEL GULLET | OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.
